items.title: Zeke Mullins interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Hartford, New York, June 9, 2017

ctx.x: Can you name a few of the tunes that you might have been playing back then?
Oh boy. I don’t know. “Sweet Lorraine.” “You Can’t Give Me Anything but Love,” Boy.
And did you have a lead sheet? Like melody and chords? How did you learn the songs?
